notes: Two stacked 4ms row cases, each powered by its own 4ms Row Power 30 at the left end. Lower row measures exactly 104 HP cheek to cheek and is full. Upper row: the panels sum to 101 HP plus a ~2 HP white strip (n6), so it measures ~103 HP; its capacity is left null because I can't tell whether the strip is a 2 HP blank, a 3 HP blank (which would make it 104 HP), or part of the case. The px_per_hp values are means; the photo has strong keystone (looking down), so each row's scale grows from top edge to bottom edge (row 0: 38.3 -> 39.9, row 1: 40.2 -> 42.1) and the overlay uses that sloped mapping. Two open_set calls the owner should confirm: Row Power 30 vs catalog ROW POWER 25, and the original 8-stage Voltage Multistage vs catalog Voltage Multistage 10 (per Verbos's own page a 10-stage update in the same 30 HP: near-identical name, width and look, so a good hard negative or a revision the owner may choose to map). All widths come from the photo. Commons description is just 'DSC00346', no module list.
